sources.title: apsua/ApsuaTranslator-Lite-v1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ApsuaTranslator-Lite-v1 is a bidirectional Russian-Abkhaz model distilled from ApsuaTranslator-v1. Compared with the full model, its weight file is 6× smaller on disk, loaded weights use 3× less memory, and translation is 2.5× faster. It was developed as part of the Abkhaz Language Corpus project.

sources.title: Math for AI Safety: An invitation for mathematicians - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract. Artificial intelligence threatens to outrun human understanding and control.
